title: Stunning 4BR Home in Rosemary Beach with a Private Pool
meta_description: Stay at Kidd Cottage, a 4BR, 4BA Rosemary Beach vacation home, with a private pool, steps from the beach access point, and a full open kitchen. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- Professionally designed- Private swimming pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)- Garage parking- 5-7 minute walk to the beach- 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes- Access to all Rosemary Beach amenities, including 4 private community poolsSurrounded by palm trees that sway gently in the warm sea breezes, Kidd Cottage is located within the exclusive coastal community of Rosemary Beach. Boasting two gorgeous levels and lots of luxurious living space, this stunning home has four magnificent bedrooms, multiple living areas, and lots of outdoor space to soak up the sunshine— including your very own private swimming pool. With the beach access point only a few steps from your front door, the location of Kidd Cottage makes your next coastal vacation as effortless as possible.With a striking blue and white color palette, the modern and great open room certainly lives up to its name. Boasting high ceilings and lots of thoughtful architectural touches, this room makes it easy for large groups to gather together for cocktails and conversation. High above, the soaring exposed ceiling beams add the perfect dash of coziness to this cavernous room, and a large HDTV is surrounded by two crisp, white sofas and multiple armchairs.A large center island anchors this chic, efficient space in the open kitchen with bar stool seating. The bright white cabinets and gleaming quartz countertops surround the premier appliances, which include a gas range, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, a high-efficiency dishwasher, and an in-drawer microwave. Next to the kitchen is a formal farmhouse dining space with seating for 12.The first of four serene bedrooms are located down the hall and features a queen-sized bed, a desk space, and an HDTV. A full bathroom and a laundry are accessible from the hallway. This level also includes garage parking.On the second floor, the primary bedroom suite is complete with a luxe king-size bed, a huge HDTV, a seating area, and a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom with a separate tub and shower. One more bedroom suite includes a king-size bed and attached full bathrooms.Also, on the second level, you’ll find a fresh and flexible bunk room with two built-in, twin-over-twin-size bunk beds that kids of all ages love. A full bathroom is just across the hallway.Kidd Cottage was built to take full advantage of the surrounding natural coastal beauty and includes an outdoor lounge with tons of seating, a gas grill, and a glittering private swimming pool that is the perfect spot to cool off after a hot day at the nearby beach. The popular Cabana community swimming pool is just around the corner, and when you’re in the mood for a night out or a casual lunch with friends, the charming village of Rosemary Beach is only a short bike ride away.First Floor (Sleeps 2)Open GREAT ROOM and LIVING AREAFormal DINING SPACEChef-inspired KITCHENPOWDER ROOMBEDROOM SUITE w/queen-size bed and ENSUITE BATHROOM (Sleeps 2)SLEEPER SOFA (Sleeps 2)Outdoor SWIMMING POOLLAUNDRY ROOMSecond Floor (Sleeps 10)PRIMARY BEDROOM SUITE w/king-size bed and ENSUITE BATHROOM (Sleeps 2)BUNK ROOM w/ 2 twin-over-twin-size bunk beds (Sleeps 4)GUEST BEDROOM w/king-size bed and ENSUITE BATHROOM (Sleeps 2)Also available for rental is the adjacent Kidd Carriage House with a discount for the carriage house if both are rented simultaneously.STR-067000 TDT-067000
